Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states, "Calculus was not invented yet." The Predicted Answer includes, "Harvard did not offer calculus when it opened in 1638 because calculus had not yet been developed as a recognized subject. Newton and Leibniz created their versions of the calculus only in the 1660s and 1670s, decades after Harvard began instruction." This clearly conveys the substance of the ground truth—that calculus had not been invented at the time Harvard was founded. The Predicted Answer provides even more context and factual detail, but it directly includes the vital fact from the Ground Truth Answer.

Decision: TRUE
